display_name: Zero-knob same-day day-open undercut reclaim long, intraday flat (v2; undercut ordering + capital/cost + null.base_seed frozen)
hypothesis: On XAUUSD H1 as stamped by the Vantage terminal clock in xauusd_data.csv, the open of the first printed bar of each calendar day is a day-local reference. After any prior same-day bar (j < i) prints low < day_open (undercut_seen_before_i), a long-only reclaim when bar i with server hour in 9..15 closes strictly above day_open, with fixed ATR SL/TP and force-flat at server hour 16, has no free parameters. Same-bar undercut+reclaim does not qualify. Any edge must come from day-open support recovery after an earlier dip under Standard STP spread costs. Hours are pure server labels — not claimed Tokyo/Asia wall-clock or London–NY overlap.

clock_contract.source: MqlRates time via Mt5ArchBridge TimeToString; fetch_data tags as UTC without conversion
clock_contract.hours_present_develop_note: develop bars show server hours 1..23 (hour 0 typically absent)

rule.day_open: open of the first printed H1 bar of the calendar day (server clock date of time stamp)
rule.undercut: undercut_seen_before_i = any(low[j] < day_open for j < i on the same calendar day); sticky once true for the day; evaluated before entry on bar i
rule.undercut_ordering: prior bars only (j < i). A bar that itself prints low < day_open does not set undercut for its own close evaluation. Same-bar undercut+reclaim → no entry. Prior-bar undercut + later reclaim close > day_open → eligible.
rule.entry: once per calendar day: if flat and undercut_seen_before_i and server hour in entry_allowed_hours_server and close > day_open, enter long at that bar close
rule.exit: SL/TP or force flat at close of bar with hour>=flat_hour same day; no overnight

null.algorithm: For each calendar day with m bars: (1) ref_0 = open[0], ref_j = close[j-1] for j>0; (2) inc_j = (open,high,low,close)/ref_j componentwise; (3) circularly rotate the m increments by k∈{0..m-1}; (4) rebuild continuous OHLC path from the original day open by chaining rotated increments so each bar unit's open/ref and true-range/ref ratios are preserved as a multiset. Timestamps and spreads remain fixed. No absolute-price day-block paste; no foreign-hour geometry on a new close.
null.notes: Canonical session null for protocol 2.2. base_seed=20260808 is frozen (no seed shopping). Required because day_open, undercut_seen_before_i, and reclaim use within-day path geometry.

execution_contract.bar: closed H1 only; no same-bar open entry from open of signal bar

atr.formula: TR ewm(alpha=1/14, adjust=False).mean() — MetaTrader-style Wilder via EWM
atr.value_used_at_entry: atr[i] on signal bar close (no lag beyond causal TR/EWM definition)
forbidden_alternatives: standard EMA of TR with different alpha convention unless identical to Wilder alpha=1/14
using atr[i-1] for SL distance when entering at close[i]

entry.signal: evaluated at bar close of index i
entry.fill: enter at close[i] when signal true and flat
entry.costs_on_entry_bar: round-trip trade_cost is COMPUTED from entry bar i at fill, STORED on the open trade, and DEDUCTED once when exit PnL is booked (house convention; not a balance debit at entry)

costs.measured_at: entry bar i (spread_pts[i], lots sized at entry)
costs.deducted_at: exit PnL booking only: balance += gross_pnl - trade_cost; NOT deducted from balance or equity at entry fill

exit.first_eligible_bar: i+1 (exits begin next bar after close-entry; no same-bar exit)
exit.sl_fill: exit at sl price when low[j] <= sl
exit.tp_fill: exit at tp price when high[j] >= tp (only if stop not hit first)
exit.time_flat_fill: exit at close[j] when hour[j] >= flat_hour_server
exit.end_of_series: if still in position on last bar of entry day, force close at last close with trade_cost already charged; never carry overnight

sizing.raw_lots: risk_cash / (stop_dist * CONTRACT_SIZE) with risk_cash = balance * risk_pct
sizing.skip_if: lots < min_lot OR stop_dist * CONTRACT_SIZE * min_lot > risk_cash
sizing.balance_source: realized balance (starts at start_balance=10000; compounds on booked pnls)

no_overnight.entry_gate: enter only if the calendar day has at least one bar with hour >= flat_hour_server
no_overnight.day_boundary: if position still open when calendar day changes, fail-closed: do not apply next-day SL/TP (discard open risk without overnight fill invention)

execution_contract.house_convention_source: scripts/xau_family_early_server_range_break_flat.py + server_hour_window_flat simulate(): START_BALANCE=10000; trade_cost at entry; pnl = gross - trade_cost at exit; bal += pnl

capital.risk_cash_at_entry: balance * risk_pct (current realized balance, not equity, not start_balance)
capital.balance_update: balance += pnl only when a trade is booked at exit (or end-of-series same-day force close)
capital.equity_while_open: eq[i] = balance + (close[i] - entry) * CONTRACT_SIZE * lots * pos when pos != 0 (floating MTM; trade_cost NOT subtracted from equity until exit)
capital.pnl_on_exit: pnl = (exit_px - entry) * CONTRACT_SIZE * lots * direction - trade_cost; direction = +1 for long
capital.net_profit: sum of booked trade pnls (each already net of that trade's trade_cost)
capital.max_drawdown_pct: peak = running maximum of equity series; dd[i] = (peak[i] - eq[i]) / peak[i] if peak[i] > 0 else 0; max_drawdown_pct = max(dd) * 100
capital.two_trade_sizing_invariant: After trade1 books pnl1, balance becomes start_balance+pnl1; trade2 risk_cash uses the updated balance (realized-balance compounding)

supersedes.reason: v1 left undercut sticky-state vs entry ordering ambiguous (same-bar undercut+reclaim), did not freeze start_balance / realized-balance compounding / equity formulas / cost-deduction timing (charter said charge-on-entry; house deducts at exit booking), and did not freeze null.base_seed (strict harness allowed seed shopping).
